Writing reference

Heading

A heading introduces the subject of a passage and tells readers what follows.

Title

A title identifies a work or document by the name its author gave it.

Section

A section groups related material under one heading in a longer document.

Section 8

Housing choice vouchers help families rent homes in the private market.

Title 42

The public health law that covers the work of the county health office.

Untitled

An oil painting from 1962 that the artist never named, now in the lobby.
